BiblicalUsage: Orpah was a Moabite woman, the wife of Chilion, the son of Naomi. She married into the family in Moab, and when Naomi set out for Bethlehem, Orpah kissed her mother in law and went back to her people, while Ruth stayed.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Orpah's kiss is the saddest moment in Ruth: she loved Naomi, she wept, and she went back to her gods — while Ruth clung to her.
